study type: Qualitative study (data derived from a multicentre randomized controlled trial)
outcome: Global theme of breastfeeding as 'A journey to finding one's unique way in breastfeeding'
cohort: 270 mothers of preterm infants (< 37 gestational weeks) providing written comments through questionnaires during the first 12 months after birth.
finding: Mothers of preterm infants are in an exposed and vulnerable situation when initiating breastfeeding during the first year, leading to a unique journey wherein each mother navigates through breastfeeding depending on her individual situation.
